summary: The current advice is to wait before buying anything in India, though Hindustan Copper is the preferred choice if investing anyway, and to buy JPMorgan Chase in the United States. Analysts note that JPMorgan has grown steadily over five years and pays a dividend, but company insiders have recently sold over five million dollars of stock without buying any. On the Indian side, they discuss splitting ten thousand rupees between two companies like Exide Industries and a non-auto business to reduce risk instead of putting it all in Tata Motors.
